name: n-eye
description: Privacy-preserving visual perception for lightweight browser agents

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @n-eye/protocol build && pnpm -r run test && PYTHONPATH=apps/planner-api .venv/bin/pytest apps/planner-api/tests
scripts.bench:privacy: N_EYE_BENCH_WRITE=1 pnpm --filter @n-eye/extension exec vitest run src/__tests__/bench-t019.test.ts
scripts.bench:visual: N_EYE_BENCH_WRITE=1 pnpm --filter @n-eye/extension exec vitest run src/__tests__/sih-visual-eval.test.ts src/__tests__/bench-t019.test.ts
scripts.bench:performance: N_EYE_BENCH_WRITE=1 pnpm --filter @n-eye/extension exec vitest run src/__tests__/bench-t019.test.ts src/__tests__/benchmark.test.ts
scripts.bench:all: N_EYE_BENCH_WRITE=1 pnpm --filter @n-eye/extension exec vitest run src/__tests__/bench-t019.test.ts
